title: improve smb-direct dissection over iwrap
description:
SMB-Direct can run over iwarp, which is based on tcp.

We need to get the reassembling correct in all layers.

With these patches the following capture is displayed
much better:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/uploads/__moin_import__/attachments/SampleCaptures/smb-direct-man-in-the-middle-02-reassemble-frames9.pcap.gz

commits_data.title: packet-smb-direct: also call payload dissector if tree is NULL
commits_data.message:
packet-smb-direct: also call payload dissector if tree is NULL

This is needed to get the COL_INFO and COL_PROTOCOL set
from the payload dissector.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.message:
packet-iwarp-mpa.c: fix mpa_fpdu dissecting without marker pdu fragmentation

commits_data.title: packet-iwarp-mpa: make use of tcp_dissect_pdus() to reassamble pdus
commits_data.message:
packet-iwarp-mpa: make use of tcp_dissect_pdus() to reassamble pdus

There might be more than one mpa frame in a tcp pdu
or one mpa frame spans more than one tcp pdu.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
